issues.title: Disconnected control and label layout
issues.description: Radio indicators are placed on the far right while item labels remain left-aligned across wide cards.
issues.evidence: Large empty gap separates radio selectors on the far right from left-aligned text.
issues.suggestion: Group radio indicator and label content adjacently with consistent inline spacing.
issues.triageNote: Verified in-browser: Radix RadioGroup defaults dir to "ltr" and renders it on the group div, so on the RTL page the radio-group subtree kept an LTR layout (text left-aligned, radio isolated at the far right edge) — inconsistent with the mirrored page. Fixed in radio-group.tsx by resolving the inherited DOM direction when no dir prop is passed. Also flipped the choice-card demo to the adjacent radio-first pattern (matching the description/rtl demos) per the audit suggestion to group indicator and label adjacently. Residual on pair-153 itself: the eval page composes content-first with full-width cards, which is a read-only composition (blocked-external); the component-level root cause is fixed.
